authorization: Owner directed all remaining proof DAG; this is an exact subtarget of the named Volterra majorization/convergence obligation.

definitions.u: continuous real function on [0,L], units L, with u(x)>=0
definitions.f_K(x): x if K=0; sinh(sqrt(K)*x)/sqrt(K) if K>0, positive sqrt

required_proof_content: Treat K=0 without division by sqrt(K).

For K>0 justify repeated Volterra substitution for arbitrary continuous u, the exact iterated-kernel coefficients, absolute convergence of the sinh majorant, and vanishing remainder using boundedness of u on [0,L].
Universal functional theorem; finite truncation and sampled/numeric checks are insufficient.
boundary_controls: No assumption u<=f or target derivative inequality
excluded: Matrix Jacobi ODE to scalar integral inequality
